name: Yoast SEO Premium
tagline: WordPress SEO guidance, internal linking, redirects, schema, and support

pricing.notes: Working normalization from the official public pricing structure. Recheck the source page immediately before publication.

tiers.name: Yoast SEO Free
tiers.limits: Unlimited WordPress installations; 1 focus keyphrase/post; Wincher integration tracks 1 keyphrase/post and 5 keyphrases total.

tiers.name: Yoast SEO Premium
tiers.limits: 1 website/domain; up to 5 focus keyphrases/page; Wincher tracks up to 5 keyphrases/post and 5 total on its free integration; 1 Google Docs seat; 20+ languages.

pricing.freeTierCaps: Unlimited WordPress installations; 1 focus keyphrase/post; Wincher integration tracks 1 keyphrase/post and 5 keyphrases total

pricing.hiddenCosts: Each additional website needs another subscription. Extra Google Docs seats cost $5/month each; VAT may be added.

verdictSummary: Yoast SEO Premium's solo core is compact: build a focused WordPress SEO plugin audit for user-owned sites that crawls pages, records technical signals, and exports a prioritized CSV and HTML report. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on proprietary data, index, crawl scale.
coreLoopDIY: Build a focused WordPress SEO plugin audit for user-owned sites that crawls pages, records technical signals, and exports a prioritized CSV and HTML report.
replacementScope: personal replacement for the core loop
requirements: permission to crawl the target site
whatYouLose: fresh proprietary keyword, backlink, or ranking data
whyPeopleStillPay: Yoast SEO Premium: The dashboard is reproducible; the expensive part is continuously collecting, cleaning, storing, and defending a useful index of the web.
ongoingBurden: Maintain crawling etiquette, parsers, rendering, rate limits, search-engine changes, data freshness, storage, and reporting logic.

notes: Strong page because Yoast SEO Premium separates a compact personal workflow from the value of long-term polish.
prompt:
Build a usable personal replacement for the core loop of Yoast SEO Premium.
Use exactly this stack: Python 3.12 + Typer + SQLite + Playwright.
Primary job: Build a focused WordPress SEO plugin audit for user-owned sites that crawls pages, records technical signals, and exports a prioritized CSV and HTML report.
Start from an empty folder and create the complete working project.
Make the default mode single-user and private.
Store user data locally unless the core job requires the declared self-hosted database.
Do not add analytics, telemetry, ads, or third-party accounts.
Put every secret and external credential in .env and provide .env.example.
Use realistic sample data that is clearly labelled and easy to delete.
Implement the smallest polished interface that completes the core loop end to end.
Include clear empty, loading, validation, success, and failure states.
Add import and export so the user is not trapped in the app.
Use accessible keyboard navigation, labels, focus states, and sensible contrast.
Validate untrusted input and never log secrets or private file contents.
Deliberately exclude these paid-product advantages: historical competitor datasets and support; fresh proprietary keyword, backlink, or ranking data; proprietary web and keyword indexes.
Do not fake integrations, network effects, proprietary data, model quality, compliance, or security claims.
Where an external API is optional, keep the app useful without it and explain the degraded mode.
Write focused unit tests for the data model and the most important workflow.
Add one end-to-end smoke test that proves the core loop works.
Create a README with setup, permissions, architecture, data location, backup, and limitations.
Add scripts for install, development, test, build, and a production-style local run.
Run the tests and build before finishing, then fix errors rather than merely describing them.
